column1: # Common-name → Gaia DR3 source_id alias table used by the Catalog facade.
# One entry per line, tab-separated: common_name<TAB>gaia_id
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Matching is case-insensitive and trims surrounding whitespace.
# "Sol" and "Sun" are deliberately omitted here: the Sun has no Gaia DR3
# source_id (Gaia cannot observe its own reference frame), and the facade
# synthesizes a StarContext from solar constants when those names are
# resolved. See Catalog::resolve for the special-case branch.
# Entries marked (fixture) are present in crates/ymir-catalog/fixtures/
# gaia_sample.parquet; the rest only resolve against the full 116k-row
